notes.title: Update for Caturday, September 12!
notes.notes:
Greetings, Fateful! We have a patch for you this fine Caturday to keep your tiles shaking and your temples totes grounded.

[img]http://www.fatetectonics.com/external_assets/catlas.gif [/img]


[h1]Version 1.8.4[/h1]

[list]
	[*][b]Tomes on tales[/b]. Add proper descriptions for final two Fates.[/*]
	[*][b]Armageddon it[/b]. Fixed a series of issues related to meteor showers that can't finish because the world is destroyed too quickly.[/*]
	[*][b]A+ for DJ[/b]. Fixed the Full House achievement.[/*]
	[*][b]They’re already dead![/b] Fixed several errors resulting from Fates trying to use disasters in places where tiles had fallen.[/*]
	[*][b]Chaotic alignment[/b]. Small layout adjustment on the age summary screen.[/*]
[/list]

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]

[list]
	[*]There’s an issues with Ragnorosa after “beating” the game that can cause the game to crash at the start of a new Age.[/*]
[/list]
